long_biography.plain_text:
MCS & Associés developed in Paris as a specialist in acquiring and managing receivables. Although the circumstances of its founding are unclear, by 2003 Patrice Mourruau was its majority shareholder. As chairman and chief executive, he directed a platform that purchased troubled bank portfolios, serviced loans and worked with international capital partners in France and Germany.

Mourruau transferred daily leadership to a new management board in 2011 and became chair of the supervisory board. He later represented a shareholder group in the consolidation of related investment holdings before leaving MCS governance when Cerberus acquired the group. His subsequent mandates included investment and property companies in France and Luxembourg, without establishing a single operating business comparable with MCS.
